name: 10mathchem
description: Builds the Self Learning sites (chemistry, math, history) into one static folder (dist/) for hosting.

scripts.build: npm run build:chemistry && npm run build:math && npm run build:history && node site-host/assemble.mjs
scripts.build:chemistry: npm ci --prefix chemistry-self-learning && npm run build --prefix chemistry-self-learning
scripts.build:math: npm ci --prefix math-self-learning && npm run build --prefix math-self-learning
scripts.build:history: npm ci --prefix history-self-learning && npm run build --prefix history-self-learning
